title: Gideon and the Orbit
author: Mirabel Dunmore
blurb: Ada Iversen, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
